How to replace an icon with an alternative one?
I’ve restarted my device and the icon pack isn’t applied anymore. The default icons have been restored.
Why do the icons look pixelated on my device?

string-array.name: answers
string-array.item: You need a launcher or system icon pack manager with icon pack support. Check the “Apply” tab for supported launchers.
Open the “Apply” tab in the bottom navigation bar and select your installed launcher. If your launcher does not support one-tap apply, select Pure Icon Pack manually inside your launcher’s settings.
Open the “Icons” tab or tap any category chip on the Home screen to browse and search all included icons.
Long-press the app icon on your home screen, choose “Edit” in your launcher’s menu, and pick any icon from Pure Icon Pack.
This happens when the icon pack is moved to external storage. Keep the icon pack installed on internal storage.
Your launcher may scale icons aggressively. Increase the launcher icon scale to 115%–120% in launcher settings.
